isolation.reviewed: blind-packet-v2.json and its nine sealed artifacts only
isolation.excluded: parent directory, original case, README, Git history, author report, and conversation context

mathematical_check.object: T_n(rho) is well-defined over Z[rho] for every integer n >= 1.
mathematical_check.row_operation: Descending R_i <- R_i - rho R_{i-1} uses an unmodified preceding row and preserves the determinant over a commutative ring.
mathematical_check.entry_formula: Entries below the diagonal cancel; entries on or above it become rho^(j-i)(1-rho^2).
mathematical_check.conclusion: The transformed matrix is upper triangular with diagonal 1, 1-rho^2, ..., 1-rho^2, hence determinant (1-rho^2)^(n-1).
mathematical_check.boundaries: n=1 and rho=+-1 are covered because the proof uses no division.

program_reproduction.polynomial_program: Recomputed n=1 through 7 exactly; all records matched the sealed output; total permutations 5913.
program_reproduction.rational_program: Recomputed n=1 through 12 at seven rational parameters; all 84 records matched the sealed output.

scope: Finite computations are diagnostic; the all-n conclusion is carried by the division-free row-operation proof.
